annotations.title: Show your account balance, credit and earnings

description: Shows your gaents account: balance in USD, money received by kind (starter credit, paid top-ups, sales), active API keys, seller earnings if you sell, and how to top up. Use it to check you can afford a paid call, or to see your balance after one. Use job_status instead for one past call's outcome and charge. Use seller_statement instead for every ledger row in a period. Free: reading your account is never charged. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST /v1/accounts gives one). Errors (isError, error.code): 401 bad_api_key.
name: account_balance

seller.description: seller earnings, or null when you sell nothing

topup.description: how to add credit and its limits
